name: Yae Tenzen
description: Yae Tenzen, codenamed Crimson Sakura and Red Number 8, is a shinobi originating from the Vollachia Empire who worked as a maid at the Barielle Estate and within the Priscilla Camp. Originally appearing in the Tanpenshuu 4 story 'Pride and Prejudice and Zombies', she resurfaces as a secondary antagonist in Arc 9.
